rough_summary.evaluation_protocol: 5-fold strictly in-fold pointwise T-norm Fuzzy-Rough excess-dependency ranking (full training fold max_samples=4096, 5 stratified bootstrap views, K*=24 budget)

preprocessing_audit.adas13_imputation_note: 6/1137 ADAS13 entries in ADNI Cohort 1 are missing and median-imputed strictly within training folds by fit_strict_preprocessor_with_params; Clinical modality-level mask remains 1.0 when >=50% of 17 clinical indicators are observed, while optional clinical_concept_masks enables sub-indicator masking when supplied explicitly.

ckd_subgroup.triage_threshold_protocol: Symmetric 80th-percentile referral threshold calibrated strictly on training fold `tr_i` per CV fold (evaluated identically under both `0.5*hes + 0.5*conf` composite and `hes_only` scores)

real_world_discordance_audit.definition: Strictly nested outer-fold clinical biomarker discordance: baseline plasma pTau (>= training-fold median) contradicting both preserved hippocampal MRI volume (> training-fold median) and normal baseline cognition (DX_bl=='CN' & CDRSB<0.5), or low plasma pTau (< training-fold median) contradicting both hippocampal atrophy (<= training-fold median) and clinical impairment; 80th/85th percentile referral thresholds are calibrated strictly on training-fold discordant patients scored by each outer fold's trained model (and training-fold medians) with zero cross-fold leakage, then applied out-of-fold and evaluated symmetrically under both `composite` (0.5*hes + 0.5*conf) and `hes_only` rules.

matched_coverage_referral.description: Matched-coverage selective referral evaluation across identical retained sample counts and coverages on the deduplicated n=198 discordant ADNI cohort (N=1,112 unique participants), reported under both strictly nested outer-fold ECDF-calibrated uncertainty ranks (zero leakage and cross-cohort scale invariance) and raw OOF scores.

survival_vis.stratification_protocol: Strict in-fold tertile risk cutoffs ([33.33, 66.67] percentiles fit on `tr_i` per CV fold)
survival_vis.xlabel: Follow-Up Time in ADNI Longitudinal Cohort (Years)

highdim_1000gene_reduct.candidate_universe_protocol: Unsupervised, label-free transductive top-1,000 MAD expressed protein-coding genes across 7 cBioPortal PanCanAtlas cohorts (18,495 common protein-coding genes -> 15,636 passing >=95% non-missing & median log2(RSEM+1)>=1.0 QC; zero outcome labels used during QC/MAD pre-screen, zero manual cancer-gene priority lists, zero alphabetical truncation; sporadic NaNs imputed strictly per training fold)
highdim_1000gene_reduct.all1000_ablation_fairness_note: DeepFuzzyTorch_4Mod_All1000 keeps use_rough_bottleneck=True and use_feature_gates=True identical to DeepFuzzyTorch_4Mod_Top20

theoretical_complexity.FuzzyRoughFeatureReducer_fit: O(K_max * D * N^2) offline once per training fold (sub-quadratic O(K_max * D * S^2) when N > max_samples=S)
theoretical_complexity.IFS_Encoder_and_RoughBottleneck: O(N * sum_m D_m * d) linear in sample size and input dimension
theoretical_complexity.CertaintyOrdered_IFSChoquetFusion: O(N * M * log M * C + N * M^2 * C) via certainty-ordered Choquet capacity + pairwise conflict tensor (avoids exponential O(2^M) subset enumeration)
theoretical_complexity.DeepConceptTSKHead: O(N * C * R) linear in concepts C and rules R
